```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
devtools::load_all("~/Documents/GitHub/nciTools")
```

## Setup

Building the local NCIt database requires Python and the Python
`rdflib` package. R communicates with Python using `reticulate`.

Check that Python is available:

```{r python-check, eval=TRUE}
reticulate::py_config()
```

Check that `rdflib` is available:

```{r rdflib-check, eval=TRUE}
reticulate::py_module_available("rdflib")
```

If required, `rdflib` can be installed into the Python environment
used by `reticulate`:

```{r rdflib-install, eval=TRUE}
reticulate::py_install("rdflib")
```

## **Download flat NCI thesaurus**  
  
```{r download flat NCIt}

NCIt_flat = nciTools::downloadThesaurus()

```

## **Normalise thesaurus**  
  
```{r normalise NCI thesaurus}

NCIt_entities = NCIt_flat |> 
  dplyr::mutate(PT = gsub("\\|.*", "", synonyms)) |>  ##  use the first synonym as PT
  dplyr::select(code, PT, definition, concept_status) |> 
  unique()

NCIt_synonyms = NCIt_flat |> 
  dplyr::mutate(synonyms = strsplit(synonyms, split = '\\|')) |>
  tidyr::unnest(cols = 'synonyms') |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  dplyr::select(code, synonyms) |> 
  unique()

NCIt_parents = NCIt_flat |> 
  dplyr::mutate(parents = strsplit(parents, split = '\\|')) |>
  tidyr::unnest(cols = 'parents') |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  dplyr::select(code, parents) |> 
  unique()

NCIt_semantic_types = NCIt_flat |> 
  dplyr::mutate(semantic_type = strsplit(semantic_type, split = '\\|')) |>
  tidyr::unnest(cols = 'semantic_type') |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  dplyr::select(code, semantic_type) |> 
  unique()

```

## **Prune flat NCI thesaurus**  

```{r prune entities}

NCIt_entities = NCIt_entities |> 
  dplyr::filter(!grepl(pattern = 'Obsolete_Concept|Retired_Concept', concept_status) ) |> 
  dplyr::select(- concept_status)

generic_entities = c("Expression Negative", "Variant Exon", "Frameshift Mutation", 
                     "Gene Amplification Positive", "Elevated Expression", "Decreased Expression", 
                     "Gain of Function Gene Mutation", "Loss of Heterozygosity", 
                     "Somatic Variation", "Gene Mutation", "Exon Skipping Mutation", 
                     "Copy Number Gain", "Insertion Mutation", "Deletion Mutation", 
                     "Splice-Site Mutation", "Gene Fusion", "Chromosomal Translocation", 
                     "Nervous System Finding", "Molecular Genetic Variation", 
                     "Chromosomal Rearrangement", "Mutation Abnormality", 
                     "Gene Amplification Abnormality", "Gene Fusion Abnormality", 
                     "Protein Truncation Abnormality", "Deleterious Mutation", "Chromosomal Deletion", 
                     "Gene Variant")


NCIt_entities = NCIt_entities |> 
  dplyr::filter(!PT %in% generic_entities)


```

  
```{r prune synonyms}

generic_synonyms <- c("Positive", "POSITIVE", "Yes", 
                      "Negative", "NEGATIVE", "Normal", 
                      'Amplified', 'Exon 9', 'Exon 11', 
                      'Exon 14', 'Exon 18', 'Exon 20 Insertion', 
                      'Insertion', 'Mutation', 'Gene Mutation', 
                      'Deletion', 'Gene Deletion', 'gene deletion', 
                      'Amplification', 'Gene Amplification', 'Rearrangement', 
                      'Gene Rearrangement', 'Fusion', 'Expression', 
                      'Overexpression', 'Underexpression', 'Loss', 
                      'LOH', 'Duplication', 'Internal Duplication', 
                      'Frameshift', 'Splice Site')


NCIt_synonyms = NCIt_synonyms |> 
  dplyr::filter(! synonyms %in% generic_synonyms) |> 
  dplyr::filter(! stringr::str_detect(synonyms, "\\(|\\)")) ## omit any synonyms containing parentheses, as these cause issues with later use as dictionary

```



```{r prune specific entity synonym}

## prune inappropriate synonyms for given entities
NCIt_synonyms = NCIt_synonyms |> 
  dplyr::filter(! (code == "C118396" & synonyms == "TP53")) |>    ## TP53 gene mutation
  dplyr::filter(! (code == "C71428" & synonyms %in% c("triple-negative breast cancer", "TNBC"))) |>    ## TNBC finding (to avoid clash with TNBC as cancer type)
  dplyr::filter(! (code == "C118809" & synonyms == 'Breast Cancer')) |>    ## Childhood Breast Carcinoma 
  dplyr::filter(! (code == "C96271" & synonyms == 'PIK3CA')) |>    ## PIK3CA Gene Mutation 
  dplyr::filter(! (code == "C104668" & synonyms == 'Exon 11')) |>    ## KIT Exon 11 Mutation 
  dplyr::filter(! (code == "C116397" & synonyms == 'Exon 12')) |>    ## PDGFRA Exon 12 Mutation 
  dplyr::filter(! (code == "C116399" & synonyms == 'Exon 18')) |>    ## PDGFRA Exon 18 Mutation 
  dplyr::filter(! (code == "C122768" & synonyms == 'Exon 14')) |>    ## KIT Exon 14 Mutation 
  dplyr::filter(! (code == "C19635" & synonyms == 'BRCA1')) |>    ## BRCA1 Gene Mutation
  dplyr::filter(! (code == "C2194" & synonyms == 'sorafenib')) |>    ## Sorafenib tosylate
  dplyr::filter(! (code == "C9107" & synonyms == 'Solid Tumor')) |>    ## Childhood Solid Neoplasm
  dplyr::filter(! (code == "C8101" & synonyms == 'Solid Tumor')) |>    ## Adult Solid Neoplasm
  dplyr::filter(! (code == "C40459" & synonyms == 'ATM'))   ## ATM Gene Mutation

```




```{r add new synonyms}

NCIt_synonyms = NCIt_synonyms |> 
  dplyr::add_row(code = 'C177785', synonyms = 'RAS Q61X') |>  ## 'RAS Q61X' as a synonym of C177785 Activating RAS Q61X
  unique()

```



```{r add new parent child relationships}

## create new relationships where C9292 (Solid Neoplasm) is a parent of all children of C3263 Neoplasm By Site, except C35813 Hematopoietic and Lymphatic System Neoplasm
new_solid_neoplasm_children = NCIt_parents |> 
  dplyr::filter(parents == 'C3263') |> 
  dplyr::filter(! code %in% c('C35813')) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(parents = 'C9292')    

NCIt_parents = NCIt_parents |> 
  rbind(new_solid_neoplasm_children) |> 
  unique()


```


## **Download NCI thesaurus, OWL format (inferred)**  
  
```{r download OWL file, eval=TRUE}
zip_file <- nciTools::downloadNCIt_OWL_inferred()

owl_file <- nciTools::extractNCIt_OWL_inferred(zip_file)

```

## **Parse OWL file**  
  
```{r parse owl file, eval=TRUE}
reticulate::source_python(
  system.file("python", "parse_ncit_owl.py", package = "nciTools")
)

g <- parse_ncit_owl(owl_file)
```

```{r extract relationships from owl file}
## parent-child relationships are not included - these will be sourced from NCIt_parents

reticulate::source_python(
  system.file("python", "extract_dataframes_from_NCIt_graph.py", package = "nciTools")
)

NCIt_relationship_types <- get_relationship_types(g)

NCIt_relationship_types <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(NCIt_relationship_types, as.data.frame)
)

NCIt_relationships <- get_relationships(g)

NCIt_relationships <- as.data.frame(
    do.call(rbind, NCIt_relationships)
)

NCIt_relationships[] <- lapply(
    NCIt_relationships,
    as.character
)

names(NCIt_relationships) <- c("subject_code", "predicate_code", "object_code")

```

```{r save results to database}
## define desired path to database
nciTools_cache = getOption("nciTools.cache", tools::R_user_dir("nciTools", which = "cache"))
db_filepath <- file.path(nciTools_cache, "NCIt.sqlite")

NCIt_sqlite_con = DBI::dbConnect(drv=RSQLite::SQLite(), db_filepath)

## write tables to DB
DBI::dbWriteTable(conn = NCIt_sqlite_con,name = "NCIt_entities", NCIt_entities, overwrite=TRUE)
DBI::dbWriteTable(conn = NCIt_sqlite_con,name = "NCIt_semantic_types", NCIt_semantic_types, overwrite=TRUE)
DBI::dbWriteTable(conn = NCIt_sqlite_con,name = "NCIt_parents", NCIt_parents, overwrite=TRUE)
DBI::dbWriteTable(conn = NCIt_sqlite_con,name = "NCIt_synonyms", NCIt_synonyms, overwrite=TRUE)
DBI::dbWriteTable(conn = NCIt_sqlite_con,name = "NCIt_relationship_types", NCIt_relationship_types, overwrite=TRUE)
DBI::dbWriteTable(conn = NCIt_sqlite_con,name = "NCIt_relationships", NCIt_relationships, overwrite=TRUE)


```

```{r example queries}

## get ancestors e.g. for Solid Neoplasm
solid_neoplasm_code = "C9292"
get_ancestors_query <- 'WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS 
    (SELECT code AS a, 0 AS distance
    FROM NCIt_parents
    WHERE code IN ($1)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT NCIt_parents.parents, ancestors.distance + 1
    FROM ancestors
    JOIN NCIt_parents ON ancestors.a = NCIt_parents.code)   
SELECT DISTINCT ent.code, ent.PT, anc.distance  FROM ancestors anc INNER JOIN NCIt_entities ent ON ent.code = anc.a ORDER BY anc.distance;' 

DBI::dbGetQuery(NCIt_sqlite_con, statement = get_ancestors_query, params = list(solid_neoplasm_code)) |> 
  formattable::formattable()

## get descendants
get_descendants_query = 'WITH RECURSIVE children AS 
        (SELECT code AS c, 0 AS distance
        FROM NCIt_parents
        WHERE code IN ($1)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT p.code, ch.distance + 1
        FROM children ch
        JOIN NCIt_parents p ON ch.c = p.parents)
    SELECT DISTINCT ent.code, ent.PT, ch.distance
    FROM children ch
    LEFT JOIN NCIt_entities ent ON ch.c = ent.code
    ORDER BY ch.distance;'

DBI::dbGetQuery(NCIt_sqlite_con, statement = get_descendants_query, params = list(solid_neoplasm_code)) |> 
  head() |> 
  formattable::formattable()


## get drug targets
drug_names = c('Sotorasib', 'Pembrolizumab', 'Bevacizumab', 'Alpelisib', 'PI3Kdelta/gamma Inhibitor ZX-101A')
get_targets_query = 'SELECT ne.code, ne.PT, ne.definition, nrt.label, nr.object_code, ne2.PT AS object_PT 
FROM NCIt_entities ne
INNER JOIN NCIt_relationships nr ON ne.code = nr.subject_code
INNER JOIN NCIt_relationship_types nrt ON nr.predicate_code = nrt.code
INNER JOIN NCIt_entities ne2 ON nr.object_code = ne2.code
WHERE ne.PT IN ($1) AND nrt.label = "Has_Target"'
DBI::dbGetQuery(NCIt_sqlite_con, statement = get_targets_query, params = list(drug_names)) |> 
  formattable::formattable()



## get cell/molecular dysfunctions for given gene(s)
gene_names = c('KRAS')
relationship_labels = c('Gene_Product_Variant_Of_Gene_Product', 'Molecular_Abnormality_Involves_Gene')
get_molecular_dysfunctions_query = 'SELECT ns.code, ns.synonyms, nrt.label AS relationship, nr.subject_code AS variant_code, ne.PT AS variant_PT 
FROM NCIt_synonyms ns
INNER JOIN NCIt_semantic_types nst ON nst.code = ns.code
INNER JOIN NCIt_relationships nr ON nr.object_code = ns.code
INNER JOIN NCIt_relationship_types nrt ON nrt.code = nr.predicate_code
INNER JOIN NCIt_entities ne ON nr.subject_code = ne.code
WHERE ns.synonyms IN ($1)'
DBI::dbGetQuery(NCIt_sqlite_con, statement = get_molecular_dysfunctions_query, params = list(gene_names)) |> 
  dplyr::filter(relationship %in% relationship_labels) |> 
  formattable::formattable()

```

```{r disconnect from database}

## disconnect
DBI::dbDisconnect(NCIt_sqlite_con)


```
